blocks.text: INN Indonesia - Health - mental health has been the issue of the society that has been ringing lately. It's due to the activity of entire layers of society that are restricted by the Covid-19 pandemic which attacked not only certain areas, but the whole world experienced it.

In Indonesia, according to Riskesdas 2018 Basic Health Research, over 19 million people are over 15 years old with emotional mental illness, and more than 12 million people are over 15 years old depressed.
One of the mental disorders contained within DSM V is Bipolar Disorder. Bipolar mental disorder is a change of mood swings that change significantly, or with two poles at odds.

Those two poles are depression and beads. Depression is a mood marked with deep sadness and can affect daily activities. The bead is a state of overjoyed mood, so irritable, hyperactivity, lots of talk, mind and attention that's easily distracted.

People who suffer from bipolar disorders will experience emotional changes without need of a clear reason. The trigger of grief that normal people think is considered simple, but for people with bipolar disorder it will trigger a prolonged depression phase so difficult to get out of that feeling.

According to DSM V, bipolar disorder classified as bipolar disorder I, bipolar disorder Il, cyclothymic disorder, bipolar due to drugs, bipolar disorders related to other medical conditions, bipolar disorders and inspecific bipolar disorders.
Bipolar type 1 is a bipolar disorder that has at least one period of beads that lasts for 7 days or more. At this type, they will experience a feeling of passion, impulsive, and full of energy.

This episode of beads that happen to people who need treatment in hospitals is because it's going to be very severe and dangerous to the patient. The suffering may experience a severe episode of depression or hypochanics before and after an episode of mania.
Type 1 bipolar types can affect men and women equally.

The next type is type II bipolar, where the patient experiences at least one episode of depression that lasts for about two weeks. The suffering of this disturbance has been in the hipomanian phase for about four days.
This type of disorder is more common in women. People who have bipolar disorders on type Il generally also have other health problems, such as anxiety disorders that make the patient worse.
Cyclothymic types are less bipolar disorder than type I and II. In this type of episode, hipomania and depression occurred about 2 years. It's usually the age of a teenager.
From some sources, there's data that reveals that there are about 46 million people experiencing bipolar disorders worldwide. One survey shows bipolar disorder in women and men each 2.8% and 2.9%.

It is possible that bipolar disorder is one of the leading causes of the sixth stability in the world. Studies reveal a lifetime prevalence rate of 1.0% for bipolar type I, 1.1% for bipolar type II, and 244 for bipolar threshold (bipolar threshold (bipolar which has a history of two hipomanic episodes of subthreshold for the rest of his life)
Conditions to bipolar disorders can be caused by neurotransmitters or brain function control.

Some experts say, this disorder also comes from a hereditary factor. The suspected risk factor could cause and exacerbally severe bipolar disorder is severe stress, traumatic experience, alcohol addiction or illicit drugs, and has a family history of bipolar disorders.
Diagnostic on bipolar disorder is required to identify and do further handling. It's done by a psychiatrist. Psychiatrist would do some pertinent observations of speech, thinking and behaving.
The psychiatrist interviewed the entire patient, then got a questionnaire, then had an examination and was eventually diagnosed with a shared diagnosis of DSM V.

Bipolar disorder has complications if not soon dealt with further. Suffering is also a risk to suffer from substance abuse, anxiety disorder, unregulated heart rate, diabetes, unhealthy body weight, and the worst of people have a suicidal mind.

The only thing that can be done to reduce the symptoms of bipolar disorder is to be able to do medication (using antidepressants, antipsychotic, etc.), psychotherapy, Electroconvulsive Therapy, Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation.
Yovita Murti Pratiwi
